title: Semi-thin Section Analysis
author: Sue Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zz5f786

steps.title: Perform Double Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix and post-fix the specimen using glutaraldehyde and osmium tetroxide in phosphate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Fix the specimen with 2.5% glutaraldehyde in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for more than 4 hours.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.
Post-fix the specimen with 1% OsO4 in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for 1 hour.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.

steps.title: Dehydrate Specimen
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the specimen through a graded ethanol series and acetone.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate using a graded series of ethanol (50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%) for approximately 15 to 20 minutes at each step.
Transfer the specimen to absolute acetone for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Infiltrate with Spurr Resin
steps.instruction: Gradually replace acetone with Spurr resin mixture.

substeps.instruction: Place specimen in a 1:1 mixture of absolute acetone and final Spurr resin mixture for 1 hour at room temperature.
Transfer to a 1:3 mixture of absolute acetone and final resin mixture for 3 hours.
Transfer to final Spurr resin mixture overnight.

steps.title: Embed Specimen
steps.instruction: Embed the specimen in medium and cure with heat.

substeps.instruction: Place specimen in capsules containing embedding medium.

steps.title: Section and Stain
steps.instruction: Slice semi-thin sections and apply stain for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Slice semi-thin sections (1 μm) using an LKB 11800 PYRAMITOME ultramicrotome.
Obtain images of anther cross-sections using a Leica DMLB fluorescence microscope.
